test_title: PYST 62: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 6 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 24 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let total capacity of the cistern = LCM of 6 and 24 = 24 units. Efficiency of (P + Q) = 24 ÷ 6 = 4 units/hour. Efficiency of P = 24 ÷ 24 = 1 unit/hour. Efficiency of Q = 4 − 1 = 3 units/hour. Time taken by Q to fill 1/4th of the cistern = (24 × 1/4) ÷ 3 = 6 ÷ 3 = 2 hours. **∴ The correct answer is 2 hours.**
